Indico Developments · Request for quotation · Package 07

Kitchens, wardrobes and built-in joinery

Katembe Ocean Views, Katembe, Maputo, Mozambique. A building with 12 T3, 3 T2 and 2 compact T2 apartments, a restaurant on floor 4, a supermarket, parking, a club house and a pool.

The plans below show where every item goes, with sizes from the architect's model. The table at the end lists each item, its specification and the quantity to price.

Elevations, types and specification

Every wall below is drawn from the architect's 3D model, seen from inside the room. Red numbers are the item numbers in the price table. Widths along the wall and heights above finished floor are in mm: measure on site before manufacture.

Joinery: specification for every kitchen, wardrobe and built-in piece

Carcass16 mm white melamine faced board (MR grade in kitchens and bathrooms), 6 mm backs, all edges banded 1 to 2 mm
Kitchen fronts18 mm MDF, greige matt lacquer, with oak veneer accents as drawn; push to open or recessed J-pull, no visible handles
Wardrobes and panelsOak veneer on 18 mm MDF, vertical flutes about 40 mm, matt lacquer seal; black frame and black details; LED strip inside wardrobes on door switch
HardwareSoft close concealed hinges 110° clip-on (3 on tall doors), soft close full extension runners, adjustable plinth legs, wall cabinet hangers on rail. Blum, Hettich or equal: state brand
HeightsBase carcass 880 on 100 to 150 plinth, worktop by stone supplier to 900; wall units 700 high from 1500 to 2200; tall units 2200; floating vanities top at 880
AppliancesBuilt-in oven, microwave, hob, hood and fridge from the appliances package: make niches to their data sheets (oven niche 600 × 600, microwave 600 × 400)
Worktops and splashbacksNot in this package (stone package). Coordinate templates after carcasses are installed
InstallSupply, deliver to Maputo and install, scribed to walls; measure on site before manufacture; 5 year carcass warranty requested
